description: Moving from another system: adds up to 100 past check-ins at once for drop-in class types (no times on the timetable, people just come in), one per member, class type and day. No pack is charged again; the visit is linked to the given pack, or the member’s pack that covered that day. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.
